title: Director of Quality
text:
Description:

**Built** **on** **Experience.** **Built** **for** **Skill.** **Built** **for You.**

Keel was formed by bringing together three industry leaders combining generations of hands-on expertise in steel fabrication, shipbuilding, aerospace, and defense manufacturing.

That means when you join Keel, you’re joining a team backed by decades of proven craftsmanship and real-world results.

We build ships, defense systems, aerospace components, and heavy steel structures that serve critical missions — and we do it with pride.

**Your Mission:**

The Director of Quality provides strategic leadership, technical oversight, and compliance governance for multiple heavy fabrication plants producing structural weldments, assemblies, and machined components for the Nuclear Navy. This role ensures full alignment with ISO 9001, NAVSEA, and customer specific requirements.

**Explore the Depth of the Role:**

* Provide strategic leadership for quality operations across three South Carolina fabrication facilities supporting U.S. Navy shipbuilding and defense manufacturing programs.
* Ensure all products meet contractual, technical, regulatory, NAVSEA, and quality requirements while driving continuous improvement in customer satisfaction and product performance.
* Lead the development, implementation, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with customer, industry, and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the primary quality interface for customers, government representatives, auditors, and regulatory agencies, leading quality reviews, audits, corrective actions, and performance discussions.
* Direct all quality assurance, quality control, inspection, test, dimensional verification, NDT, welding quality, and supplier quality activities across the region.
* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics including First-Time Quality (FTQ), Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), defect escapes, rework, audit findings, and inspection cycle time.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement initiatives to eliminate recurring nonconformances and improve manufacturing performance.
* Drive operational excellence through improved inspection efficiency, resource utilization, process standardization, and deployment of risk-based quality methodologies.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams to proactively prevent defects and improve overall manufacturing effectiveness.
* Build and sustain a culture where quality, compliance, workmanship excellence, and customer focus are integrated into daily operations at all levels of the organization.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and lead Quality Managers, Engineers, Supervisors, Auditors, and Inspectors while building organizational capability and succession plans.
* Other related duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**Mission Readiness:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or related technical discipline; Master's Degree preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive quality leadership experience in shipbuilding, defense, defense manufacturing, heavy fabrication, aerospace, or similar industries.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi-site quality organizations.
* Root cause analysis and corrective action applied to nonconformances and recurring defects
* Quality auditing, including internal, supplier, and customer audit planning, execution, and follow-up
* Data analysis and reporting using quality metrics, dashboards, and tools such as Excel, Power BI, and ERP/QMS software
* Contract and technical document review, including drawings, specifications, work instructions, and inspection plans
* Executive-level presentation and negotiation skills for customer meetings, corrective action reviews, and dispute resolution
* Quality Management Systems: AS9100, ISO 9001, Navy QA requirements, nonconformance management, and CAPA
* Welding and NDT Oversight: Weld procedures, inspection methods, and material traceability in accordance with NAVSEA requirements
* Supplier Quality: Qualifying, auditing, and developing suppliers; preventing counterfeit or nonconforming material
* Regulatory and Contract Compliance: Government source inspection, DCMA surveillance, and audit readiness
* Continuous Improvement and Leadership: Lean, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and developing quality talent
* Track and report cost of quality (prevention, appraisal, internal and external failure) and drive reductions in rework and scrap
* Support program pricing, proposals, and forecasts with accurate quality labor and resource estimates
* Evaluate the cost, schedule, and risk impact of quality decisions, such as rework, repair, and corrective action investments

*Travel Requirements:*

Between facilities as needed

*Physical Requirements:*

* May be required to stand, walk, sit, reach/pull/push with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel regularly.
* May lift or carry 50lbs. Weights exceeding 50lbs will require mechanical means to maneuver.

**Become** **a** **part** **of** **our** **Builders** **and** **you** **too** **can...**

* Uphold Safety and Quality Standards
* Embody Team Spirit
* Relentless Customer Focus
* Convey Integrity, Trust, and Professionalism
* Execute with Excellence and Velocity

**What** **Keel** **will** **build** **for** **you:**

* Comprehensive Benefit Package
* Competitive Pay
* 401(k) Match
* HSA/FSA
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Time Off
* Internal Referral Bonus Opportunities
* Shift Differentials
* Overtime Potential
* Paid on the Job Training
* Certification Sponsorship Opportunities
* Committed to Individual Career Growth
* We Do Fun Things, Plus More!

**Need** **Assistance?**

If you require a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the employment process, please email talent@keelusa.com with details about your request and your contact information. Accommodation requests are reviewed individually on a case-by-case basis. Please note that this email address is monitored only for inquiries related to reasonable accommodation requests.

*Equal* *Opportunity* *Employer* */* *Individuals* *with* *Disabilities* */* *Protected Veterans*

**What** **we** **build,** **builds us.**
